title: diff-forms-pullback widget params
description: The pullback of a top form picks up the Jacobian determinant. For a map φ: (u,v) ↦ (x,y) and the area form ω = dx∧dy on the target, the pullback is φ*ω = det(Dφ)·du∧dv. Move the base point and pick a map; the widget shows the unit (du,dv) square in the source plane and its image — the parallelogram spanned by the columns of the Jacobian Dφ — in the target plane, whose signed area is exactly det(Dφ). This is why a change of coordinates picks up the Jacobian exactly once.

widgetId.description: DOM id for the outer <div class="widget"> wrapper.
